(()=>{
  const checks=scriptModesCase(modeVariant);
  checks.pageSource=scriptModesCase.toString().includes('checks.inlineGlobal')&&modeModule.importedSource;
  expressionCreated=modeVariant;
  checks.expressionGlobal=expressionCreated===modeVariant&&globalThis.expressionCreated===modeVariant;
  checks.expressionThis=(function(){return this})()===globalThis;
  checks.expressionStrict=(function(){'use strict';try{strictExpressionCreated=1;return false}catch(e){return e instanceof ReferenceError}})();

    ()=>{checks.bootstrapNamespace=false;return checks},
    ()=>{checks.bootstrapNamespace=true;return checks}
  );
